NOTE 3:The same bands and the same Io conditions for each band apply for this requirement as for the corresponding requirement with the PRS bandwidth ≥ 24 PRB.NOTE 4:The condition level is increased by ∆>0, when applicable, as described in Sections B.3.2 and B.3.3.NOTE 5:The Io is defined in PRS positioning subframes.
